subject: Horizon Retail: request for third-party processing map and evidence
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonretail.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@horizonretail.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: third-party processing map + SIG evidence for onboarding

Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is moving us toward a final review; security has one last ask before we can include Redwood in our supplier list. Can you provide: 

- A current roster of subprocessors (cloud providers, telemetry/observability, support/incident tooling) with clear descriptions of data they may see.
- Any completed SIG answers or an exported questionnaire (we have SOC2 but need SIG alignment) and any supporting artifacts you can share (attestations, network diagrams, data flow snippets).

I attached the vendor roster template procurement prefers — if you can fill and return by EOD Friday (Jun 4) that would keep us on the timeline. If internal teams should coordinate (security/legal), please loop them in.

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Vendor Risk, Horizon Retail
oliver.grant@horizonretail.com

Attachment: vendor_roster_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonretail.com>, security@horizonretail.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: third-party processing map + SIG evidence for onboarding

Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Looping in Mina (compliance) and Rachel (security) to help assemble the roster and the SIG export. 

Quick notes: 
- We have an up-to-date SIG export (I attached a PDF version of the answered questionnaire) and a vendor roster template we can populate.
- For telemetry we use a managed tracing/metrics provider (Honeyglass Observability) — only aggregated runtime telemetry; KV cache traces are redacted.
- Cloud: primary compute + storage is on GCP (projects scoped per-customer for Private deployments); hosted API customers use our multi-tenant hosting on AWS in us-west-2.
- Support tooling: Zendesk (ticketing) and Sentry (error telemetry) — both configured with minimal PII access and contractual DPA.

Next steps: Mina and Rachel — can you confirm the list below and add any missing subprocessors, fill the attached roster, and drop any artifact links (attestations, SOC2 report redaction page) by EOD Thu (Jun 3)? That gives us a day to consolidate for Horizon’s Friday deadline.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: sig_questionnaire_export_v1.pdf; internal_notes_toc.txt (references)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: third-party processing map + SIG evidence for onboarding

On Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 11:02 AM jonas.weber@redwood.com wrote:
> Jonas — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Looping in Mina (compliance) and Rachel (security) to help assemble the roster and the SIG export.

Thanks Jonas — I pulled the roster and started populating. Summary for Horizon: 

- Cloud providers: GCP (projects for Private), AWS (hosted infra/us-west-2), Azure (limited test instances) — contact points and contract owners included in the spreadsheet.
- Telemetry/observability: Honeyglass Observability (aggregated metrics/traces), Datadog for infra alerts (only metadata), Sentry for error grouping (no raw user payloads stored).
- Support/CS: Zendesk (ticketing), Intercom for product messaging (opt-in), and PagerDuty for on-call alerts.
- CD/Build: GitHub Actions (CI), Artifactory (artifact storage).

Artifacts we can provide today: 
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF (link in Drive)
- SIG export (attached) — contains question-by-question answers; we mark any control exceptions and point to mitigations.
- Network diagram and data flow excerpt (drive link).

I'll attach the filled roster (vendor_roster_filled.xlsx) and include quick notes on data access level per vendor. Rachel — can you verify the telemetry descriptions and confirm there are no additional telemetry processors that would need explicit mention?

Mina Haddad
Director, Compliance & Privacy, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_roster_filled.xlsx (prepared)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@horizonretail.com>, security@horizonretail.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: third-party processing map + SIG evidence for onboarding

Oliver / Horizon security team — forwarding the consolidated materials. Per your template we attached the completed roster and an exported SIG PDF. Highlights: 

- No subprocessors have access to unredacted customer prompt content. Runtime telemetry retains only anonymized tokens for debugging; persistent storage is scrubbed.
- Honeyglass (telemetry) and Datadog ingest aggregated metrics and limited trace metadata; we have contractual controls and encryption-in-transit.
- Support vendors (Zendesk, Intercom) receive customer metadata and support thread content when customers initiate a support request; we've noted which fields are considered PII and how we mask them.

Attachments: vendor_roster_filled.xlsx; sig_questionnaire_export_v1.pdf; SOC2_redacted_2026.pdf

Planned follow-up: if you need signed attestations or our DPA redline, Mina can route that to procurement. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if any item needs clarification — propose Mon Jun 7 11:00am PT if that works.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
